verdict.rationale: Postman's docs state that it runs scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) and after it (post-response) [postman-docs-12], and that scripts add dynamic behavior, dynamic parameters and pass data between requests [postman-docs-17]. Together with variables and environments [postman-docs-47], this covers both chaining requests and transforming data, and those scripted collections can run in CI via the Postman CLI or Newman [postman-docs-19, postman-docs-42]. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on the scripting API and data-transformation (massaging) capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted request chaining.
